_comment: PINNED quarantine set — the e2e gate (scripts/run-suites.mjs) FAILS if the live QUARANTINE map drifts from this list, so a suite can never leave the gate silently (see Phase 21b item 1: verify-week entered while adminpay left, count stayed 4, nobody noticed). Changing what is quarantined — adding, removing, OR swapping — must be an explicit, reviewable edit to THIS file in the same commit as the QUARANTINE map change. Keep it sorted.

reasons.verify-cost-tables.mjs: hardcodes live figures, drifts with data — see 2026-08-20
reasons.verify-counts-as-regular.mjs: WRITES PRODUCTION — flips fin_venue_fields.counts_as_regular_play on field 22 via the service role and restores it in a finally. Exited 2 mid-run on 2026-08-24 and left the flag ON, moving ATH Pearland's match count and cost estate-wide with no change_log row. Off until rewritten so it proves the exception without mutating a live Finance flag. A try/finally restore does not survive the process being killed.
reasons.verify-field-cost-month.mjs: WRITES PRODUCTION — clears a real fin_venue_cost_overrides amount through the UI and types it back, or DELETEs the row when there was none, in straight-line code with NO finally. A cleared override changes a venue's cost for a closed month. Off until rewritten without the write. On 2026-08-24 its restore completed only because the failing assertion came after it.
